name: Rokuten Neon
source:
[u][b]The Promised Messiah[/b][/u]
[b]SR Evaluation Value: Unmeasurable[/b]
Occupation: Third-year student
Height: Slightly tall
Bust: Large

She is actually the protagonist’s childhood friend. Since they were young, they had always felt a subtle attraction toward each other. However, one day, she suddenly disappeared without a trace, and since then, there had been no contact. The [url=/c150333]protagonist[/url] had always wondered about her, but…
It turns out that Neon is destined to save the world—a Messiah.
That said, she herself has absolutely no intention of playing that role. Perhaps, if she "grows" as an SR, she might come to accept her fate as the Messiah. 
It was at that moment that she reunited with the protagonist, who had just arrived at the academy.

[i]What kind of girl is she?[/i]
Growing up in a unique family environment, she developed a somewhat blunt and curt personality. She prefers cats over humans. Despite this, the protagonist has been the one person she has admired since childhood. As things stand now, the idea of becoming a Messiah is the last thing she wants.

「Being loved by everyone... it's disgusting, isn't it?」
